segment.source: Also include the CSS files below in the frontend. They are always loaded in CKEditor, regardless of this setting. Note: the icons in CKEditor are based on Font Awesome 7.3.1 Pro+.

A list of the Font Awesome CSS files to use in CKEditor and, when **Load CSS in frontend** is enabled, in the frontend. Both `EXT:` paths and absolute paths (for example `/fileadmin/...`) are supported. Tip: remove the styles you do not use to keep the frontend light.
Register icons in TYPO3 Icon API

Register all icons from the sprite files below as TYPO3 Icon API identifiers (for example for use with `<core:icon>` or `IconFactory`). This can register tens of thousands of icons, so it is disabled by default. Flush all caches after changing this setting.

A list of Font Awesome SVG sprite files to register in the TYPO3 Icon API. Only used when **Register icons in TYPO3 Icon API** is enabled. Only list the sprite files you actually use. Flush all caches after changing this list.
